comment: We support the National Digital Architect as a lasting in-government role. We recommend also naming a transitional composition/integration ("weaver") function that assembles DPGs into a working national stack and owns the seams before a national curator exists, handed off as capacity grows. WHO supplies the blueprint; composing it into a working, accountable stack is a distinct capability.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: We support the National Digital Architect as a lasting in-government role. We recommend also naming a transitional composition/integration ("weaver") function that assembles DPGs into a working national stack and owns the seams before a national curator exists, handed off as capacity grows. WHO supplies the blueprint; composing it into a working, accountable stack is a distinct capability.
